description: Overlay an image watermark onto an existing video and render a new output file. The video and watermark image are read only; output_path is created or overwritten. Supports named, pixel, and percentage positions plus opacity, margin, CRF, and preset controls.

crf.description: Optional FFmpeg CRF override from 0 to 51, where lower means higher quality.
crf.title: Crf

image_path.description: Absolute path to an existing local image file used as an overlay or watermark.
image_path.title: Image Path

input_path.description: Absolute path to an existing local video file. The input file is read only.
input_path.title: Input Path

margin.description: Non-negative edge margin in pixels for named positions.
margin.title: Margin

opacity.description: Watermark opacity from 0.0 fully transparent to 1.0 fully opaque.
opacity.title: Opacity

output_path.description: Destination video path. Auto-generated when omitted; an existing supplied path may be overwritten.
output_path.title: Output Path

position.description: Watermark position: named position such as bottom-right, pixel dict {"x": 100, "y": 50}, or percentage dict {"x_pct": 0.5, "y_pct": 0.5}.
position.title: Position

preset.description: Optional FFmpeg encoding preset: ultrafast, fast, medium, slow, or veryslow.
preset.title: Preset

name: video_watermark
title: Add video watermark
